name: sdlc
description: Personal story SDLC: design-review gate, full story lifecycle, and autonomous story-run/design-run/review-run pipelines plus product-design-review. Tracker-agnostic (Jira/Linear/none, resolved per repo), solo-dev aware (direct-to-main branch model, --incognito local-only mode for contributing to repos you don't own), configurable per-agent model tiers, worktree-isolated story execution, and optional local-only design docs.
